admission.shape: closed body `classDef` / `class` / `style` styling statements, one trailing `:::class` annotation on a declaration / boundary title / edge / json close, flat `@{...}` properties, and single-line json payloads
admission.width_policy: wide_240 admission only; narrow_40 measured live
admission.twin_rule: the twin is the same fixture with the styling statements, `:::class` annotations and `@{...}` properties removed; the art above the footer must be cell-equal

selection.rule: the last usecase fallbacks whose only non-admitted inputs are the closed body styling surface

review.reviewer_agent: independent read-only adversarial code review, fresh general-purpose agent, D-458 usecase body grammar, 2026-11-24: round 1 REQUEST-CHANGES (BLOCKER quoted `@{...}` silently dropped; blast radius on four drawn rows; blind twin; empty annotation; class scope; trailing comma; braces inside json strings; mirror four-colon divergence), round 2 APPROVE after fixes (task aba09a2cce8422b7f, resumed for the re-check)
review.note: The roster regeneration and the d117 counts are deferred to the post-approval OfficialMatrix rerun; both landed in the same commit.
